description: This is a shell script that generates C code for command categories and command lists from input files. It processes command definitions, categorizes them, and outputs C structures for use in software that manages commands.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

methods.name: command_list
methods.description: Reads commands from a file, skipping comments and excluded programs, and outputs the filtered list.

methods.name: category_list
methods.description: Extracts category names from a string and returns a sorted unique list.

methods.name: define_categories
methods.description: Outputs #define statements assigning bit flags to categories.

methods.name: define_category_names
methods.description: Outputs an array of category name strings for use in C code.

methods.name: print_command_list
methods.description: Outputs a C array of command names and help info, including category bits.
